job.job_description:
We are hiring Machin learning Engineer-




LLM Engineering & Deployment: Lead the deployment, monitoring, and scaling of Large Language Models (LLMs) and Small Language Models (SLMs) across secure hybrid cloud/on-premise environments using containerization.

• Context & Data Flow: Design and implement robust systems for LLM context building (e.g., advanced RAG pipelines, feature stores) and perform context analysis to optimise prompt strategies and manage session history efficiently.

• Model Optimisation: Apply techniques like LoRA, Quantisation, and pruning to tune models for low-latency, high-throughput inference on required hardware (CPU/GPU).

• ML System Architecture: Design and build the foundational MLOps infrastructure, ensuring reliable model versioning and automated testing for all ML services.

• Backend Integration: Implement high-throughput Python services/microservices (FastAPI) for serving ML models and handling the communication layer between the model and the consumer.

• Code Quality & Mentorship: Drive best practices in MLOps, system design, performance testing, and provide technical guidance to the engineering team. Must-Have Skills Core Engineering & MLOps (2+ Years):

• Python Mastery: Expert-level Python programming with a focus on writing high performance, maintainable code for ML services.

• Model Serving APIs: Strong experience designing robust, scalable APIs (FastAPI, Flask) used exclusively to serve ML models and handle inference requests.

• MLOps Platforms: Hands-on experience with MLOps tools for model versioning, serving, and monitoring (e.g., MLflow, Sagemaker, or equivalent internal tooling).

• System Architecture: Proven understanding of Microservices and Event-Driven Architecture for model serving pipelines.

• Tools & Infrastructure: Expert in Docker and utilizing containerization for deploying ML models across diverse environments. LLM & ML Specialization (2+ Years Mandatory):

• LLM & SLM Mastery: Expertise in integrating, optimizing, and hosting Large Language Models (LLMs) and Small Language Models (SLMs) in production (e.g., using vLLM or Ollama).

• Context Engineering: Deep practical experience in context building for LLMs (e.g., advanced RAG strategies, chunking, indexing) and performing context analysis.

• Model Tuning: Proven experience with PEFT techniques (LoRA, QLoRA) and hardware-aware optimization (Quantization).

• Neural Networks: Hands-on experience with deep learning models and frameworks like PyTorch or TensorFlow.

• Core ML Systems: Experience implementing and deploying various ML solutions, such as Recommendation Engines, clustering, or forecasting systems.
